_comment: Decisions on the words that are both the name of a maker and a word of function (tools/word_collisions.py, tests/check_word_collisions.py). meaning: same | multi | different (a homonym, with a fence). Decided 2026-10-12 from the data files; a new collision must be added here with its note.
